title: Handset capture rejects UUID calls and lacks separate quote SLA
found_on: Preflight for real handset acoustic capture
symptom: Recorder export and acoustic verifier accept only out-prefixed call IDs, blocking the native UUID workflow. The acoustic gate still imposes the response target on quotation calculation.
cause: Legacy call-ID validation and quotation gate predate the UUID call mode and owner-approved separate calculation SLA.
fix: Accept canonical UUIDs in recorder and verifier without changing provenance; add explicit --quote-sla separate while preserving strict default, mandatory quote boundaries, first-audio gate and >=20 non-quotation content samples. Add handset suite to SIP adapter CI.
verified: UUID regressions fail on prior recorder and verifier. All 45 handset tests pass: 28 acoustic verifier, 3 local HTTP server, 14 browser/audio tests. Separate mode retains evidence failures, exact-1200 rejection and minimum non-quote counts. Corrected assets served on Mac loopback; no microphone started by agent.
effect: Full CI 41285082027 passed. UUID WAV and JSON successfully exported with separate quotation SLA available. Actual capture is invalid due to sample_clock_discontinuity, independently of UUID support; handset qualification remains outstanding. Original runtime configuration unchanged.

title: Playback replacement loses the previous output completion receipt
symptom: item_28 started three transcript segments but has no final response timing in either archive or full engine log. Strict gate correctly rejects the incomplete population.
cause: ensureTurnLocked resets an active old owner on new valid generation dispatch without reporting its played audio. A held interruption can allow a final transcript to advance the tracker before explicit Interrupt.
fix: Snapshot the old exact owner and heard prefix before replacement; report outside the player mutex. Preserve opener adoption and suppress receipts for unplayed turns.
verified: Baseline regression fails all four new-turn/revision begin/audio cases and heard-prefix test. Focused race suite and 30 repeated replacement/ack cases pass. Full CI 41286136566 passed verify and simulate. Fresh original-config SIP candidate: 10 normal outputs, no missing/duplicate/unverified records, no receiver warnings, two scripted interruptions completed and five archive files verified. Native engine 9895 deployed at 15:58:40; idle readiness and no-dial adapter preflight pass.
effect: Preserves the old playback owner in accounting and history. Prior 7fc4237 binary retained; original configurations, native Journal, other engines and Active Call unchanged. Historical missing record remains unverified; neither short simulation nor the clock-discontinuous handset capture establishes the latency goal.

title: Handset capture has an unlocated sample-clock discontinuity
symptom: Saved 382.149-second mono 48 kHz capture has matching WAV hash but capture_complete=false and sample_clock_discontinuity. Gap positions were not retained.
cause: AudioWorklet context-frame continuity check failed; the historical sidecar cannot distinguish gap direction, count or location. Underlying browser/audio cause remains unverified.
fix: Retain total discontinuity count and first 64 expected/actual frame offsets for future recordings, without relaxing integrity validation or altering historical files.
verified: All 46 handset tests and full CI 41286136566 pass. Served recorder assets contain bounded discontinuity diagnostics for the next page load. Underlying browser/audio clock cause remains unverified; historical recording remains invalid.
effect: Actual handset p95 remains unqualified. Next capture needs a clean recording integrity preflight; server normal p95 1260 ms is separately measured.
